import zipfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

with zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx") as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    sheet_xml = z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml")
    wb_xml = z.read("xl/workbook.xml")

print("parts:", names)

def local(tag):
    return tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1]

wb = ET.fromstring(wb_xml)
print("sheets in workbook.xml:")
for sh in wb.iter():
    if local(sh.tag) == "sheet":
        print("  ", sh.attrib)

root = ET.fromstring(sheet_xml)
print("sheet root tag:", root.tag)

rows = [el for el in root.iter() if local(el.tag) == "row"]
print("row elements:", len(rows))
for row in rows:
    cells = [el for el in row if local(el.tag) == "c"]
    print("row", row.attrib.get("r"), "cells:", len(cells))
    for c in cells[:20]:
        print("   ", c.attrib, ET.tostring(c, encoding="unicode")[:200])
